Peak Table Object

Source: R/peak_table-class.R
peak_table-class.Rd

S3 objects of class peak_table store chromatographic peak data along with associated metadata and reference spectra.

Components

A peak_table object contains the following elements:

  • tab: The peak table itself – a data.frame of intensities in a sample x peak configuration.

  • pk_meta: A data.frame containing peak meta-data (e.g., the spectral component, peak number, and average retention time).

  • sample_meta: A data.frame of sample meta-data. Must be added using attach_metadata.

  • instrument_meta: A data.frame of instrumental metadata transferred automatically from the chromatograms.

  • ref_spectra: A data.frame of reference spectra (in a wavelength x peak configuration). Must be added using attach_ref_spectra.

  • args: A vector of arguments given to get_peaktable to generate the peak table.

Methods

The following methods are available:

  • print.peak_table()

  • dim.peak_table()

  • head.peak_table()

  • tail.peak_table()

  • row.names.peak_table()

  • subset.peak_table()

  • summary.peak_table()

  • [.peak_table

See also

get_peaktable() for creating peak_table objects

Examples

# See get_peaktable() for creation examples
# To access peak_table components:
data(pk_tab)
pk_tab$tab          # peak table
